need.title: Make a request
need.text: Big or small. You’ll find others with the same concern there.

offer.title: Make an offer
offer.text: Skills, time, things and knowledge. Also as a link to files and folders.

group.title: Start a group
group.text: A shared purpose: a project, a club or a demand to an authority. With goals, people in charge and votes.

initiative.title: Title
initiative.text: A demand to a responsible office: with debate, secret ballot and a duty to answer.
initiative.similarText: Together you achieve more. Support the existing initiative or carry on.
initiative.body: What is it about? Why does it matter?
initiative.easyHint: optional · short sentences, one statement each
initiative.easyPlaceholder:
There is no drinking water at Harras.
We want a fountain.
initiative.placeText: Everyone can vote. The votes of the people living here are binding.
initiative.addresseeText: After a successful vote, the addressee receives your initiative with a 6-week deadline to answer.
initiative.addresseeFree: Not listed? Name of the office
initiative.reviewHint: You can keep editing after publishing. Every change stays visible in the history.

concrete.name: concrete
concrete.hint: A clear title says what should change.

place.name: located
place.hint: Place and level decide who is affected.

addressee.name: addressed
addressee.hint: Someone has to be able to decide.

why.name: justified
why.hint: A few sentences on why it matters.

voice.title: Voice an opinion
voice.text: Make yourself heard and get talking with people in your area.

purpose.title: What is the group for?

project.title: Getting something done together
project.text: A project, a club, a neighbourhood. With goals, tasks and roles.

demand.title: Demand something
demand.text: A demand to a responsible body, with debate, secret ballot and a duty to answer. If it passes, a group forms to carry it out.

purpose.later: The purpose may evolve: goals can be changed at any time, and an initiative turns into a group.
